description: Source code implementing the Device.STOMP data model object, including initialization, connection management, parameter registration, and callback functions for a STOMP protocol interface.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_Init
methods.description: Initializes the STOMP component, registers parameters, and sets up the connection table.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_Start
methods.description: Initializes the STOMP connection array from the database and starts SSL context.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_Stop
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the module, disables connections.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_StartAllConnections
methods.description: Starts all enabled STOMP connections.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Queues a message on a specified STOMP connection.

methods.name: DEVICE_STOMP_ScheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnect for a specified STOMP connection.

methods.name: ValidateAdd_StompConn
methods.description: Validates if a new STOMP connection can be added.

methods.name: Notify_StompConnAdded
methods.description: Handles actions when a new STOMP connection is added.

methods.name: Notify_StompConnDeleted
methods.description: Handles actions when a STOMP connection is deleted.

methods.name: Get_StompConnectionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a STOMP connection.

methods.name: Get_StompLastChangeDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last change date of a STOMP connection.

methods.name: Get_StompEnableEncryption
methods.description: Gets the EnableEncryption parameter for a connection.

methods.name: Set_StompEnableEncryption
methods.description: Sets the EnableEncryption parameter for a connection.

methods.name: Validate_HeartbeatPeriod
methods.description: Validates heartbeat period parameters.

methods.name: Validate_RetryInitialInterval
methods.description: Validates the initial retry interval parameter.

methods.name: Validate_RetryIntervalMultiplier
methods.description: Validates the retry interval multiplier parameter.

methods.name: Validate_RetryMaxInterval
methods.description: Validates the maximum retry interval parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompEnable
methods.description: Handles changes to the Enable parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompHost
methods.description: Handles changes to the Host parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompPort
methods.description: Handles changes to the Port parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompUsername
methods.description: Handles changes to the Username parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompPassword
methods.description: Handles changes to the Password parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_StompEnableEncryption
methods.description: Handles changes to the EnableEncryption parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_VirtualHost
methods.description: Handles changes to the VirtualHost parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_EnableHeartbeats
methods.description: Handles changes to the EnableHeartbeats parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_OutgoingHeartbeat
methods.description: Handles changes to the OutgoingHeartbeat parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_IncomingHeartbeat
methods.description: Handles changes to the IncomingHeartbeat parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_RetryInitialInterval
methods.description: Handles changes to the ServerRetryInitialInterval parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_RetryIntervalMultiplier
methods.description: Handles changes to the ServerRetryIntervalMultiplier parameter.

methods.name: NotifyChange_RetryMaxInterval
methods.description: Handles changes to the ServerRetryMaxInterval parameter.

methods.name: ProcessStompConnAdded
methods.description: Reads parameters for a specific STOMP connection from the database.

methods.name: FindUnusedStompParams
methods.description: Finds the first free slot for a new STOMP connection.

methods.name: DestroyStompConn
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a STOMP connection slot.

methods.name: FindStompParamsByInstance
methods.description: Finds a STOMP connection slot by its instance number.

methods.name: EnableStompConnection
methods.description: Enables a STOMP connection with current parameters.

methods.name: ScheduleStompReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnect for a STOMP connection.
